campaign.title: Classify and estimate bad-prime and nonunit M1 period fibres

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit only literal theorems for masked rational sums modulo small prime powers, nonunit phase conductors, and 2-adic trace correlations. Preserve the actual physical symbol and directed-degree normalization.

frozen_target.question: Can the remaining small-prime, nonunit-K, and full 2-adic reciprocal-period fibres be classified and bounded target-safely inside the exact hard M1 cross-group operator?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Bound a nonempty complete-fibre subaggregate of R_*>rho_*, mathfrak_a<M^2/rho_*^2 by X^epsilon(D/B)J^(14/5), preferably through directed degree Delta<=rho_*^2, or isolate the exact smaller actual-symbol survivor.
scope: transition-flattened smooth nonaxial M1 principal row only
J^(13/18)<C<=J^(3/4) and exact deep d support
all three classes, both signs, reflected orientations, modulus multiples, and Ramanujan centering
small primes, nonunit K, and full 2-adic reciprocal periods
no affine or aperiodic estimate without an exact interface
no M2, upper conductor, cone edge, assembly, endpoint, R5-Full, or exponent claim

completion_criteria: Retain normalized rows, centered Fejer ownership, and Q^(-5/12).
Classify the complete mask at p=2,3,5,7 and nonunit-K factors before counting.
Prove both directed degrees for every selected complete fibre.
Keep Round-87 and Round-88 owners exactly once.
Prove a nonempty target-safe package or an actual-symbol no-go with an exact residual.
Audit signs, modulus multiples, Ramanujan terms, support, perfect powers, self-return, and current sources.
Complete clean blind, constructive, and hostile/source gates.

review_seams.requirement: Classify complete small-prime and 2-adic masks, not just phase numerators.
Track v_p(K), trace descent p^(2j), and every local normalization.
Prove in- and out-degree bounds on complete fibres after prior deletions.
Retain the fourfold symbol, centered Fejer kernel, prior owners, and Q^(-5/12).
Keep affine/aperiodic, M2, upper conductors, endpoints, and exponent separate unless proved.
